selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What helps belief become strong inside a Muslim?
questions.answer: Worship does.

questions.question: What can happen if belief is not helped by worship?
questions.answer: It can stay weak and not do much.

questions.question: What two kinds of things are included in worship here?
questions.answer: Doing what Allah tells us and staying away from what He forbids.

questions.question: What does the passage say worship can bring in this life and the next life?
questions.answer: Happiness in both.

questions.question: Besides happiness, what else can worship help put in good shape?
questions.answer: A person’s life here and in the Hereafter.

questions.question: Worship is a special relationship between whom?
questions.answer: Between the Creator and His servant.

questions.question: Why is worship important for a person’s character?
questions.answer: It helps belief become part of who the person is.

questions.question: Is worship only for one person alone, or can it help groups too?
questions.answer: It can help both people and groups.

questions.question: What is one main idea of the whole passage?
questions.answer: Worship helps belief grow strong and brings good in this world and the next.

questions.question: What makes belief settle deeply in a believer?
questions.answer: Worship does.

questions.question: What are we doing in worship according to the passage?
questions.answer: We obey Allah’s commands and avoid His forbidden things.

questions.question: What part of a person can stay weak if it is not supported by worship?
questions.answer: The part that knows and feels the truth inside.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the condition of the Muslim world?
questions.answer: It shows what happens when belief is weak.

questions.question: What kind of happiness comes from worship?
questions.answer: Happiness now and later in the Hereafter.

questions.question: How does worship help life besides giving happiness?
questions.answer: It helps organize life.

questions.question: Does the passage say worship helps only one person, or also the community?
questions.answer: It helps both the person and the community.

questions.question: What kind of bond is worship called?
questions.answer: A noble bond between Allah and His servant.

questions.question: What should a Muslim child learn from this passage?
questions.answer: Worship is very important because it strengthens faith and brings goodness.

questions.question: According to the passage, what puts belief into a person’s character?
questions.answer: Worship.

questions.question: What does worship include doing?
questions.answer: Following Allah’s orders.

questions.question: What else does worship include not doing?
questions.answer: Things Allah said not to do.

questions.question: What does the passage use as proof that weak belief is a real problem?
questions.answer: The condition of Muslims today.

questions.question: In which two places does worship bring happiness?
questions.answer: In this world and in the next world.

questions.question: Is worship described as low and ordinary or high and honored?
questions.answer: High and honored.
